issues.concern: The headword '末' has meanings beyond just 'time-general', including 'end/tip' (spatial) and 'future/outcome' (abstract). The current tag is too narrow and misleading for the full scope of the word.
issues.suggestion: Add 'general' or 'abstract' to better cover the non-temporal senses, or replace 'time-general' with a broader tag if a single one is preferred.
